possibilities.connection: AutoClip turns long recordings into short clips, Depth Pro 2 gives metric depth that stays consistent across frames, and the ffmpeg-skill lets a coding agent apply local edits, so depth mattes can drive blur, relighting or parallax across a whole batch of clips.
